{{Top}}
[[File:Gardulla-FFp58.png|thumb|200px|[[Gardulla Besadii the Elder/Legends|Gardulla the Elder]], a famous [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] and gangster]]
{{Quote|You're a murderer also. You killed Jabba the Hutt in cold blood, assassinated him with hatred in your heart. See yourself for what you really are!''"<br />"''I killed that thug Jabba in self-defense. He was the most corrupt and vile gangster in the universe!|[[Trioculus]] and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]]|<ref name="Zorba">''[[Zorba the Hutt's Revenge]]''</ref>}}
'''Gangsters''' were usually criminals, who participated as members of criminal organizations. Gangsters were prevalent across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. Sometimes known as thugs, gangsters often engaged in extortion, intimidation, bribery, and even murder to wield influence or instill fear in individuals or organizations.<ref name="TOTJA">[[Tales of the Jedi (audio drama)|''Tales of the Jedi'' audio drama]]</ref>

Some kept a low profile, engaging in low-level extortion rings or drug trafficking, such the sale of [[Death stick/Legends|death sticks]] by the [[Bando Gora/Legends|Bando Gora]] crime organization,<ref name="SWBH">''[[Star Wars: Bounty Hunter]]''</ref> or the robbery and hijacking of [[Starship/Legends|starships]] and their freight, by [[Bogga]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] and his [[Bogga's enforcer gang|Enforcers]].<ref name="TSNS">''[[Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi – The Saga of Nomi Sunrider]]''</ref> Other gangsters engaged in much more widespread and obvious forms of illegal activity, such as the numerous slavery rings run and operated by the various Hutt clans.<ref name="ROTJ">{{Film|VI}}</ref>
